policy: No model is vendored in this repo and none is ever fetched silently. A model downloads exactly once, only when the user passes --allow-download, and single-file models are verified against the sha256 pinned here before being cached. Whisper models are multi-file Hugging Face repos resolved by faster-whisper into its own cache; their pin is the model identifier documented here.
